messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: high error rate detected for customer AcadiaBank VPC gateway streaming (ws) — 10m spike, 20% error, 504/timeouts. Severity: P1.
Elaine (oncall): ack — looking now, pinging SRE.
Miguel (sre): pulling logs — I see repeated `websocket: write timeout` and `upstream 504` from gateway-proxy. Connection churn ~3x baseline.
Elaine (oncall): good find. Is this limited to Acadia's dedicated pool or broader?
Simone (eng-runtime): metrics show the dedicated pool for acadia-dedicated-1 has increasing queue_latency and KV cache misses on stream resume. Hosted fallbacks unaffected.
Ash (eng-platform): routing table shows a recent config push to gateway timeouts for keepalive from 25s -> 10s at 10:12 UTC. Could be causing aggressive disconnects.
Jamie (solutions): oncall, can we temporarily bump keepalive for Acadia only while we triage? Linda, can you reach out to Acadia SRE?
Linda (acct): calling them now, FYI I'll ask for impact confirmation.
Miguel (sre): quick mitigation idea: switch Acadia's route to `longpoll-fallback` so their client isn't forced to websocket right now. That avoids streaming path until we fix.
Simone (eng-runtime): agree. Also possible to increase ws ping interval and server-side read timeout to prevent mid-stream drop. Which is faster?
Elaine (oncall): routing change seems fastest. Miguel, can you run the route cmd?
Miguel (sre): running ->
```
redwoodctl route set --customer acadiabank --gateway vpc-gw-7 --mode fallback-polling --reason "ws timeouts spike 2167801234"
```
Miguel (sre): applied. Observability: switching now.
Elaine (oncall): metrics: error rate for Acadia down from 20% -> 6% within 45s. Latency for polling higher but successful.
Ash (eng-platform): I'll roll back the keepalive change for that gateway to 25s for Acadia only. Patch rolling now via `gw-config` canary.
Simone (eng-runtime): putting a targeted increase to `stream_read_timeout` and enabling more lenient backoff:
```
stream_read_timeout: 60s
ws_retries: exponential(2s, 30s)
```
Elaine (oncall): doing a handoff to daytime SRE at 2167801400. Tagging Miguel for follow-on.
Miguel (sre): noted. Running live diagnostics — seeing persistent backlog on acadia-dedicated-1 host-03. I'm going to drain new streams from host-03 and failover to pool host-05.
Simone (eng-runtime): command to drain:
```
redwoodctl pool drain --pool acadia-dedicated-1 --hosts host-03 --failover-host host-05 --grace 30s
```
Miguel (sre): drain initiated. host-03 connections migrating.
Linda (acct): Acadia SRE on call says their client will accept fallback for now and appreciates the temporary fix. They asked for timeline for root cause.
Jamie (solutions): communicating next steps: (1) preserve logs/trace for the window 10:05–10:20 UTC, (2) redeploy kernel patch if needed, (3) propose longer-term increase to ws keepalive and retry jitter for their VPC.
Ash (eng-platform): root cause hypothesis: gateway keepalive change + a sticky host with degraded network path -> rapid reconnects -> KV cache churn and queue buildup on host-03. We'll run network checks and check NIC error counters.
Elaine (oncall): current status: impact reduced, live mitigation in place (polling fallback + pool drain + keepalive revert). Notifying incident channel and paging rotation for postmortem.
Miguel (sre): collecting perf counters and tcpdump from host-03. Saving artifacts to /mnt/incidents/2167801234/.
Simone (eng-runtime): schedule: urgent triage meeting in 30m to decide if we need a runtime hotfix. I'll prepare regression tests.
Jamie (solutions): I'll draft customer-facing note for Linda to send. Linda, want me to include suggested config changes and timelines?
Linda (acct): please include the mitigation steps and ETA for root cause analysis. I'll send within 1h.
Elaine (oncall): handoff complete to Miguel. If anything spikes, page oncall-escalation.
Miguel (sre): acknowledged. Post-incident tasks created: INC-216780 (collect logs), INC-216781 (runtime regression), INC-216782 (gateway config audit).
incident-bot: Incident INC-216780 created and notified #postmortems.
Elaine (oncall): thanks team. Will update thread after triage meeting. :thumbsup:
